post.summary: Minimax Hailuo AI video generation API. Supports minimax-t2v for text-to-video, minimax-i2v for image-to-video, and minimax-i2v-director for director mode with camera/movement instructions.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the format of the response returned by the server. If not specified, the default format is `application/json`; if specified as `application/x-ndjson`, the response will be returned in a block-streaming format of JSON (NDJSON) separated by newline characters.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

model.description: The model used for generating videos has a default value of `minimax-t2v`.

action.description: The operation type for video generation. When set to `generate`, it will generate a video based on the prompt.

callback_url.description: The callback URL that will be called after the video generation is complete.

first_image_url.description: You can specify the URL of the first frame image to generate a video from the image.
